summary.text: Andy Whitt is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 6 who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Whitt worked in banking before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Whitt attended Louisiana State University's Graduate School of Banking.
He served as vice president of First American Bank and later as senior vice president and Madison County executive of First National Bank, and he sits on the Athens State University Foundation Board.
Whitt assumed office in the Alabama House on November 7, 2018.

In the 2025-2026 session Whitt chaired the Economic Development and Tourism Committee, was vice chair of the Financial Services Committee and of the Madison County Legislation Committee, and also served on the Limestone County Legislation Committee and the Ways and Means General Fund Committee.
